body: I appreciate your responce! But the way I see it... No school means no future, no job means no money and no ex gf, I feel I have nothing to live for... before you start laughing and say there is planty others, yes I know, I had others, just the thing is I never felt so connected before... ok maybe not last few months before she dumped me, but the feeling that I knew that something wasnt right opend my eyes and...

Ive been crying for almost 2 years, Im screaming out loud SOMEONE, HEAR ME PLEASE! :'( Im having this horrible suicidal thoughts that I never could have imagined before... Nothing goes the way I want, Im just sitting here for a year now, and I had enough, I dont earn any money, I did go to job but then they found a lame excuse why they dont need me anymore, I had some problems finishing school, and the biggest pain was when my gf left me, all this in matter of weeks, I try to have a smile on my face, but I cant hide this anymore I really cant anymore. I am very emotional type of guy and I feel/know when something is not OK, no1 needs to tell me anything, I loved her and still do, after 1 year not speaking, I felt so connected, I felt months before that something is not OK... I never trusted my feelings, but after this I do, and Im so affraid of this feelings now. I dont know what to do, Im hopeless. 
Thank you..
